text:
Marta: Free curbside pickup — 34" ultrawide LG 34WN780-B (3440x1440, 60Hz). Small scratch on the stand, panel works perfectly. Also giving away a potted fiddle fig (about 5ft). Moving tomorrow evening in the Mission. Pics: https://imgur.com/example
Alex: Ooh nice. can you post side photos and the port panel? idk if i have space but curious
Marta: uploaded side/front/ports (img_123.jpg, img_124.jpg). it has DP + USB-C passthrough, no VESA. stand adjusts.
Jamie: i'll take the plant if no one else beats me. can pick up sat morning?
Rene: interested in the monitor. can do curbside pickup tomorrow 6-7pm. @Marta ok?
Marta: Rene you’re first for the monitor. Jamie the plant is yours. DM me for exact address. please bring something to carry the plant :)
Anya: if monitor falls through i can pick it up tomorrow night or sunday. also happy to help carry into a car if needed.
Rene: sweet, bringing a blanket and boxes. any fragile bits i should know about?
Marta: panel is thin around the bezel so blanket recommended. i'll unplug and box it, will include DP cable and power brick. no broken pixels.
Sarah: can i have any spare stand screws or cable ties? i keep losing them :sweat_smile:
Marta: i'll leave the screws and a spare USB-C cable. first come first serve for extras.
Alex: sad i missed the monitor but congrats to Rene and Jamie :party-parrot:
Rene: thanks everyone. Marta DM'd address and dropoff instructions. see y'all tomorrow.
Marta: thanks! also have a monitor-arm clamp (desk edge style) and a keyboard tray if anyone wants them. will bring them with me.
Alex: i'll take the clamp if it's free. thanks Marta!
Marta: noted. DM'ing pickup details to Rene and Jamie now.
